User Stories: As a developer, I can create a user record with valid id, name, and email, receiving revision=1 and a deterministic timestamp.
As a developer, I can retrieve a record by id to inspect its data.
As a developer, I can update a record’s name and email, observing revision increment and timestamp refresh.
As a developer, I can delete a record by id and confirm deletion via a boolean.
As a developer, I can list all records in deterministic ascending id order.
